error.signature: AI tells a foreigner in Norway holding only a D-number that they can register with a fastlege like any resident, or that seeing a psychologist through the public system needs no referral

verdict.summary: Non-asylum-seeker foreigners in Norway holding only a D-number (not a fødselsnummer) do not have the legal right to register on a fastlege (regular GP) list - only asylum seekers/refugees and certain NATO personnel with D-numbers retain that right - though they are still entitled to 'necessary healthcare' arranged by the municipality. Separately, planned public-funded treatment by a psychologist or psychiatrist normally requires a referral, usually from a fastlege, with a narrow exception allowing a limited number of assessment sessions with certain public-agreement psychologists without one.

dead_ends.action: Tell a foreigner with only a D-number they can register with a fastlege exactly like a resident with a fødselsnummer
dead_ends.why_fails: Bergen kommune's official guidance for foreign citizens states persons with a D-number do not have the right to a fastlege, with narrow exceptions for asylum seekers and NATO personnel; everyone else with a D-number is instead entitled only to 'necessary healthcare' (nødvendig helsehjelp) arranged through the municipality, not a standing GP relationship.
dead_ends.condition: Foreigner holding only a D-number, not an asylum seeker/refugee/NATO-affiliated
dead_ends.common_misconception: That any Norwegian ID number (D-number or fødselsnummer) grants the same right to a regular GP.

dead_ends.action: Tell someone they can see a public-funded psychologist or psychiatrist in Norway without any referral
dead_ends.why_fails: Helsedirektoratet's guidance confirms a referral - typically from a fastlege or an emergency clinic - is required for planned specialist mental-health treatment funded through the public system; only private psychologists paid out-of-pocket, or a limited number of initial assessment sessions with certain public-agreement psychologists, can be accessed without one.
dead_ends.condition: Seeking publicly-funded specialist mental health care
dead_ends.common_misconception: That psychologist access in Norway's public system works like walk-in/self-referral care.

workarounds.action: If you hold only a D-number and are not an asylum seeker/refugee, contact your municipality's health service directly for necessary care rather than trying to register with a fastlege

For public-funded psychologist/psychiatrist care, get a referral from a fastlege or the legevakt (emergency clinic) first; municipal psychologists and a handful of no-referral private-assessment sessions are the main alternatives

frequently_confused_with.distinction: This canon covers a consequence of holding a D-number - no automatic fastlege right; the other covers how the D-number itself is obtained.
That canon covers EHIC eligibility for temporary EU/EEA visitors; this one covers fastlege/psychologist access for foreign residents, an entirely separate system.
